requirements.statement: Repository observation emits deterministic sorted repository-relative file facts with byte size and SHA-256 content identity.

Observation rejects unsafe exclusion paths, applies explicit exclusions without converting observations into declarations, and observes active control-plane configuration from the filesystem regardless of Git ignore or tracking state.

Repository Observation emits a portable manifest with explicit exclusions and bounded nonregular-entry limitations, and provides immutable exact-byte source views with conflict-checked hypothetical changes that remain distinct from actual observed state.

Repository Observation offers caller-supplied operational limits on ordinary files, total traversed entries including directories, source bytes and path bytes, rejects over-budget metadata before hashing or whole-input allocation, and returns the same canonical observation as ordinary discovery when inputs fit. Its neutral resident-enabled retained-input helper admits bytes before tokenization, records exact input counters, prevents active-budget reset and retains sticky exhaustion without acquiring language, policy, job or publication authority. Ordinary unbounded observation and inactive helper behavior preserve their existing semantics.
